comments.text: Starts the game. Sets music and sound on, then continues at restart. A hardware reset comes here through the cartridge header.
Sound and music on (bit 7 clear). Only a cold start clears this flag.
Restarts the game in the demo. Sets the memory map, the VIC bank, the vectors, the VIC, the tables and the timers. The game over code at $94e1 jumps here.
Resets the game state: demo on, opponent 4, all flags clear.
RAM at $a000 and $e000, I/O at $d000. No BASIC and no KERNAL.
VIC bank 1: $4000-$7fff.
IRQ vector: $94e8.
NMI vector: $9519 (RTI).
Screen $4400, bitmap $6000.
Multicolour bitmap mode, 25 rows.
Raster IRQ at line $fa.
Clears the sprite position shadow and the sprite registers.
Saves the clean background behind the fighters.
Stops the scripts of all 8 sprites.
Sets both fighters to the start of a bout.
Builds the mirror table at $02aa.
Builds the mask table at $03aa.
With sound off, the CIA timers stay as they are.
A = 0: stops the CIA 2 timers.
CIA 1 timer A: $2710 cycles. Its IRQ calls $9e9a.
CIA 1 timer B: $5161 cycles. Its IRQ calls $991f (sound effects).
Enables the IRQs of CIA 1 timer A and timer B.
Silences the SID.
Starts the volume fade-in, one step for each frame.
